Recovery against resolved grants

A supplement to the cascade, not a reference. Foundations write recipient names consistently with each other and differently from the BMF, so a grant the BMF cannot clear may match one that already cleared. Runs after the cascade, on what it left unresolved, and promotes only what the BMF’s own top candidate corroborates. See dev/EXP-HEAD-REFERENCE.log.

pf_grant_dictionary()
Build a dictionary of resolved grant renderings
pf_recover_from_dictionary()
Recover unresolved grants against a grant-side dictionary
